newsitem.title: USA: Cuban exile planes make way back from commemoration.
newsitem.headline: Cuban exile planes make way back from commemoration.

text.p: A fleet of Cuban exile planes was making its way safely back to Miami on Monday after dropping wreaths on the spot in the Florida Strait where Cuban MiG jets shot down two planes a year ago, the U.S. Coast Guard said.
"As far as I know they are on the way back. No problems," a Coast Guard spokesman said.
Both the U.S. and Cuban governments had warned the exiles not to provoke another incident and Havana had threatened to take action if necessary.
A U.S. Coast Guard cutter was stationed on Monday in the area of the Feb. 24, 1996, shootdown in international waters north of Havana.

Four people were killed when the Cuban fighters attacked and downed two small planes on a mission from the Brothers to the Rescue organisation, which scouts for Cuban refugees fleeing the island by sea.
